camera.perspective_cues: none in image (no ground plane / horizon). Apparent height grows 342 -> 435 px (x1.27) so the astronaut ends ~21% closer to the camera than at start (if its pose height is unchanged); the image path weaves vertically (down to f16, up to f35, down to f63).
